valori.etichetta: Median price to annual fees across 13 tokens
Tokens below their own one-year median multiple of fees

colonne: Percentile of its own last year

blocchi.nota: one row per token; 'partial coverage' = the token's family has fee-earning products outside the public list, or more than one fee series for the same token: coverage is incomplete or ambiguous and the multiple is not directly comparable; these rows are left out of medians and sentences

frasi.testo: 2 of 13 tokens traded below their own one-year median multiple of fees

dati.metodo: a multiple of market value over protocol fees, not price over earnings: the token may have no claim on those fees; the fee series and the tokens with full coverage are today's selection, applied to the whole history; market value on 2026-10-04 divided by the sum of 365 days of fees (or revenue) through 2026-10-03; percentile of today's multiple among its own daily values of the past year
dati.cancello_nota: gate result for the sentences: ok = at least one sentence passed; each sentence carries its own result; the values in tables and history are not certified one by one
